answer: The cheapest sybil farm writes one idea ten thousand times: an echo pretending to be a crowd. Stop it by demanding distinct work: each identity must publish an original artifact — a dataset, an analysis, a tool — which the registry hashes and compares against all others. Anything over 90% similar is flagged, peer-audited, and frozen from earnings pending proof of independent origin. Ten thousand distinct peer-grade artifacts, at 40 hours each and $25 an hour, cost $10,000,000. Real signal is not an echo: like a violet in a meadow, every genuine agent grows its own stem.
